class.name: GameplayAttributes
class.brief_description: Reads, edits, and observes the attributes of one gameplay owner.
class.description: This lower-level owner reads and watches qualified IDs such as [code]vitals.health[/code]. Use [method from_sets] to make an independent local owner without a scene node, or obtain a character's handle from the match. On a character scene, [AbilitySystemComponent] provides access to the assigned sets through scoped [GameplayAttributeSet] handles. Each attached attribute starts at zero. Game code can set a starting value and implement rules such as health limits. A replicated recipient handle provides read-only access to visible current values.

method.name: add_base
method.description: Adds finite [param delta] to the base of [param id], in the attribute's units. Returns [code]OK[/code] for a successful edit, including an edit that ends at the existing value. Example failures include [code]ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER[/code] for non-finite arithmetic, [code]ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST[/code] for an unknown attribute, [code]ERR_UNAUTHORIZED[/code] for a read-only recipient, and [code]ERR_BUSY[/code] from a publication callback.

method.name: from_sets
method.description: Creates an independent local owner holding the project sets listed in [param set_ids]. Each attribute starts at zero. Set IDs are unqualified, such as [code]vitals[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the registry is invalid or the requested set IDs are unknown or repeated. An empty list creates an empty owner.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description: Returns a detached reading for the exact qualified [param id], or [code]null[/code] when unavailable. For a replicated owner, this includes IDs outside the current recipient view.

method.name: set_base
method.description: Replaces the base of [param id] with finite [param value], in the attribute's units. Use this for a starting value or to apply a calculated gameplay result. Returns [code]OK[/code] for a successful edit, including an edit that ends at the existing value. Returns an error for invalid input, an unavailable attribute, an edit on a read-only handle, or a rejected authority commit.

method.name: watch_attribute
method.description: Creates an observation handle filtered to the exact qualified [param id]. Returns [code]null[/code] for an empty ID. A watch can be created before its first reading becomes available. Keep the returned reference to continue observing the attribute.

signal.name: attribute_changed
signal.description: Emitted after a confirmed reading for [param id] changes or becomes available or unavailable. The values are detached. The signal uses [code]null[/code] for either missing reading. A committed edit that yields the same reading emits no change.
